emitted.gauss:
# Healthy linear model
library(rstanarm)
fit <- stan_glm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars, seed = 1234)
print(summary(fit), digits = 3)

# Every number the summary printed, as a plain matrix you can index:
as.matrix(summary(fit))

# Rhat and n_eff on their own:
summary(fit)[, c("Rhat", "n_eff")]

# The printed interval is the 80% one. For the 95%:
posterior_interval(fit, prob = 0.95)

# ... or reprint the whole summary at 95%:
print(summary(fit, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)), digits = 3)

# Divergences and treedepth, which summary() does not print:
rstan::check_hmc_diagnostics(fit$stanfit)

# Does the model reproduce your data? Convergence does not answer this.
pp_check(fit)
